scope: Training-readiness decision for the ten candidate species with at least 12 decoded iNaturalist observation photos.

reasons_not_accepted: No complete botanist-level visual label review.
Most reviewed expansion examples are outdoor/wild rather than representative indoor phone photos.
No specimen-group split proving that the same plant is absent from training and validation.
No independent indoor phone-photo test set.

species.name: Goeppertia zebrina
notes: Outdoor garden/ground observations dominate reviewed sample.

species.name: Nephrolepis exaltata
notes: Forest/tree/outdoor examples dominate; only limited apparent indoor coverage.

species.name: Asplenium nidus
notes: Epiphytic forest/tree and outdoor garden subjects dominate.

species.name: Platycerium bifurcatum
notes: Tree-mounted outdoor subjects dominate; indoor domain absent from reviewed sample.

species.name: Davallia fejeensis
notes: 16 of 20 photos share one CC BY attribution string; high author/specimen leakage risk.

species.name: Phlebodium aureum
notes: Independent indoor test and specimen grouping remain absent.

species.name: Alocasia odora
notes: Independent indoor test and full botanical review remain absent.

species.name: Dischidia nummularia
notes: Reviewed examples are mostly wild/tree-mounted and do not establish indoor phone performance.

species.name: Monstera pinnatipartita
notes: 19 of 40 photos share one CC BY attribution string; author/specimen leakage risk.

next_acceptance_gate: Confirm current per-photo CC0/CC BY status.
Review every image for the intended botanical species.
Split by photographer and plant specimen.
Add independent indoor phone photos not used in training.
Train and report top-1/top-3 plus per-class confusion.
claim_control: These ten species are candidates only and do not increase the production model beyond 101 classes.
